  One channel

and the FPGA as two independent devices. The FPGA offers 
programmability and high performance, while the Intel® 
Xeon-D runs embedded Linux - new features can be added-
in to either or both of them, providing great flexibility.

The Inventec C5020X series is generally customizable to 
accelerate workloads in cloud such virtual switch and 
storage functions, as well as in 5G RAN, edge computing, 
and other software defined networks.

devices.title: QCT QuantaPlex T42S-2U
facts: Historical QxVDI solution describes two shared PSUs for its 2U four-node T42S-2U; claims "consumes 1600 watt for each power supply". Retained as vendor marketing statement, not PSU rating or measured consumption.
QuantaPlex T42S-2U is a 2U 4-node server, which shares only two power supplies and consumes 1600 watt for each power supply.
QxVDI solution: 2 CPUs in Intel Xeon Processor family per node
QxVDI solution: 6 SATA/SAS disks per node
QxVDI solution: up to 512GB DDR4 RDIMM memory per node; memory bandwidth up to 2666MHz as stated
QxVDI solution: extra M.2 riser on motherboard supports both SATA and PCIe M.2 devices for OS boot
